cards.answer: Udyr is a stance-switching fighter and tank who uses empowered attacks and can recast a stance to Awaken it. He combines movement speed and attack-based stuns with shielding, healing, physical attack damage and magic storm damage; his damage scales with AD and AP.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance, disengage during his defensive stance, and move out of his storms.

cards.answer: Udyr has no ultimate ability: his abilities grant stances, and he can periodically recast a stance to Awaken it for an additional effect. After casting an ability, his next two basic attacks gain attack speed and reduce Awaken's cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Limit his opportunities to attack, and respect his Awakened stance effects.

cards.answer: Wilding Claw grants attack speed and empowers his next two basic attacks with physical damage based on the target's maximum health. Awaken grants more attack speed and adds maximum-health magic lightning to his next two basic attacks; the lightning chains between nearby enemies and can hit the same enemy repeatedly when other targets are lacking.
cards.counterplay: Avoid prolonged melee trades, especially when isolated against his Awakened attacks.

citations.quote: Claw Stance: Udyr first two basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to a portion of the target's maximum health. Additionally, he gains attack speed and bonus on-hit physical damage for a few seconds.

facts.claim: Wilding Claw grants attack speed and empowers his next two basic attacks with physical damage based on the target's maximum health.

citations.quote: Awaken: The next two basic attacks release a chain of lighting that bounces to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage equal to a portion of their maximum health and can bounce to the same enemy multiple times for a lack of targets. Additionally, he gains even greater attack speed for a few seconds.

facts.claim: Awaken grants more attack speed and adds maximum-health magic lightning to his next two basic attacks; the lightning chains between nearby enemies and can hit the same enemy repeatedly when other targets are lacking.

cards.priority_reason: His empowered attacks threaten substantial damage against isolated targets.

cards.answer: Iron Mantle grants a shield, and his next two basic attacks gain life steal and heal him. Awaken strengthens the shield, adds healing over time, and increases the empowered attacks' life steal and healing.
cards.counterplay: Delay burst into his shield and limit his opportunities to heal through attacks.

citations.quote: Mantle Stance: Udyr gains a shield and his next two basic attacks gain life steal and heal him.

facts.claim: Iron Mantle grants a shield, and his next two basic attacks gain life steal and heal him.

citations.quote: Recast - Awaken: Udyr increases the shield's strength, stacking with the remaining shield from the first cast, and heals every 0.25 seconds over the next 4 seconds, as well as causes the empowered attacks to instead gain doubled life steal and heal him for 2.4% of his maximum health (+ 16% AP).

facts.claim: Awaken strengthens the shield, adds healing over time, and increases the empowered attacks' life steal and healing.

cards.priority_reason: Shielding and healing can change whether committing damage is worthwhile.

cards.answer: Blazing Stampede grants a burst of movement speed and attacks that briefly stun, with a delay before he can stun the same target again. Awaken grants more movement speed and brief immunity to crowd control.
cards.counterplay: Create distance early and hold crowd control until his Awakened immunity ends.

citations.quote: Stampede Stance: Udyr gains ghosting and a burst of movement speed that decays over a few seconds. His attacks in this stance briefly stun his target, but this cannot affect them more than once every few seconds.

facts.claim: Blazing Stampede grants a burst of movement speed and attacks that briefly stun, with a delay before he can stun the same target again.

citations.quote: Awaken: Udyr gains an even greater burst of movement speed and cc-immunity for a brief duration. Cc-immunity: Crowd control cannot be applied during this time.

facts.claim: Awaken grants more movement speed and brief immunity to crowd control.

cards.priority_reason: His main approach tool combines a stun threat with Awakened crowd-control immunity.

cards.answer: Wingborne Storm surrounds Udyr with a blizzard that continuously deals magic damage and slows enemies inside; his next two basic attacks add bursts of magic damage. Awaken releases a moving storm that follows enemies, prioritizes his attack target, slows more strongly, and adds magic damage based on the target's maximum health.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the storm and avoid lingering near Udyr during his storm stance.
